text: How is it that the very sunlight does not turn to blackness before this thing, the hard earth melt and boil beneath such a burden?” Villiers was pacing up and down the room, and the beads of sweat stood out on his forehead. Austin sat silent for a while, but Villiers saw him make a sign upon his breast. “I say again, Villiers, you will surely never enter such a house as that? You would never pass out alive.” “Yes, Austin, I shall go out alive—I, and Clarke with me.” “What do you mean? You cannot, you would not dare...” “Wait a moment.
